faqs.question: Do I need a visa for Vietnam?
faqs.answer: Cambodian passport holders can enter Vietnam visa-free for up to 30 days. Our team also handles arrival paperwork and customs facilitation.

faqs.question: Do I have to pay today?
faqs.answer: No. You reserve with just your name and phone number. Our coordinator calls you within 15 minutes, and you pay only after details are verified.

faqs.question: Can my company get an official invoice?
faqs.answer: Yes. We issue corporate billing and official tax invoices — just request it during your confirmation call.

faqs.question: Is the hotel room private?
faqs.answer: The package includes premium twin/double sharing. Single private rooms are available with a small supplement upon request.
